evidence.curator_note: Bottom row of Equation 8.82, horizontal arrow labelled 'i': the protonated methyl acrylate ion CH2=CH-C(=O)-O(+)(H)CH3 formed in the preceding 'r H, a' step loses CH3OH to give the printed products 'CH3OH + CH2=CHC(triple bond)O(+)' with 'm/z 55' printed under the ion -- the ONLY numerical datum anywhere in Equation 8.82. Book draws 1 arc: a FULL (double-barbed, two-electron) arrow from the C(1)-O(11) bond up to the protonated methoxy oxygen (move <1>). Move <2>, the carbonyl O(10) lone pair closing the acylium C(1)#O(10)+ triple bond, is an implicit two-electron arrow required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). The observed_mz 55.0178 is the computed monoisotopic m/z of C3H3O+ and agrees with the printed integer 'm/z 55'; NO percentage/abundance is printed, so no relative_intensity is recorded. The m/z 55 ion is independent of R and of n -- it is the diagnostic ion this whole scheme is drawn to explain -- so it is the one product on the page whose mass is not an artefact of the curator's instantiation. INSTANTIATION (the scheme is generic in R and in the chain length n): R = CH3 and n = 5, i.e. methyl 7-hydroxyoctanoate CH3-CH(OH)-(CH2)5-C(=O)-OCH3 (C9H18O3, M+. m/z 174.1250). n = 5 is the smallest chain that makes the final 'rH, a' step of this same scheme proceed through the favoured six-membered transition state, and it keeps the book's (CH2)n-3 label meaningful ((CH2)2). NO m/z and NO percentage is printed anywhere in Equation 8.82 except 'm/z 55' on the last product; every other mass in these records is the curator's computed monoisotopic value for this instantiation, not a measured number.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.82 (the index stops at 8.14 for Chapter 8), so no MOD rule is cross-linked to this record. Same finding as 8.82g: IMS_4_41_ind1 encodes exactly this protonated-ester -> acylium + methanol cleavage but with the Equation 4.41 ring-plus-radical skeleton hard-coded into its left-hand pattern, so it cannot match CH2=CH-C(=O)-O(+)(H)CH3 (VERIFIED by RDKit substructure match: the rule's left graph spans 12 mapped atoms -- 11 heavy plus the ester proton -- and requires both a six-membered ring and a radical centre, whereas this ion has 6 heavy atoms, no ring and no radical; the ring-bearing SMARTS returns no match, the bare protonated-ester core does). IMS_4_27_2 '[_A]1[C]2{#}[O+]3>>[_A+]1.[C]2[O]3' acts on an acylium and is the wrong direction. Unmodelled.
